hook.say: True or false? Five facts about famous cities, three seconds each. The last city is slowly disappearing!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Dubai is the capital of the United Arab Emirates.
questions.fact: The capital is Abu Dhabi. Dubai is the largest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Abu Dhabi. Dubai is just the largest city.

questions.fact: The Bosphorus strait splits the city between Europe and Asia.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The Bosphorus strait splits the city between Europe and Asia.

questions.q: Paris is farther north than Montreal.
questions.fact: Paris sits at 48.9° north. Montreal is at 45.5° north.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Paris is more than 3 degrees of latitude north of Montreal.

questions.q: Casablanca is the capital of Morocco.
questions.fact: The capital is Rabat. Casablanca is the biggest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The capital is Rabat. Casablanca is only the biggest city.

questions.q: Mexico City is sinking a little more every year.
questions.fact: Groundwater pumping makes parts of the city sink about 35 cm a year.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Pumping out groundwater makes parts of the city sink about 35 centimeters a year.
